### [Italian electricity demand — forecasting from the ground up](projects/energy-demand/index.qmd)

Public Terna load data, a documented cleaning pipeline, and a measured national
benchmark. On 2,688 observations in February 2026, the weekly naive forecast
had 946 MW MAE versus 531 MW for Terna's published forecast. The comparison is
reproducible and the next modeling steps are clearly marked as work in progress.

::: {.stack}
Python · pandas · time series · Terna public API
